submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, Co0.29V0.71 (index 11) gave the highest photocurrent, 1.2e-6 A. It sits near the CoV2O6 composition (Co 0.33). The Co-rich sample at Co 0.54 gave far less (3e-8 A), and the more V-rich sample at Co 0.20 gave 8.6e-7 A, so the photocurrent seems to peak around Co 0.25-0.33.
